data.gender_notes: Devkaran is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devi (Goddess) + Kara (work) + An (male) = God's labor, God's work. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and holds significant meaning in Hindu mythology. The name Devkaran carries the meaning “God's labor, God's work” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devkaran usually hope their child will grow to embody god's labor, god's work and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes dedication, hard work, and devotion to the divine.
data.etymology: Devkaran belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's labor, God's work.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devkaran total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Devkaran" is rooted in Hindu sacred texts and culture, specifically derived from the Sanskrit language. It contains the name of the Goddess 'Devi', who is revered as the divine feminine and the mother of the universe in Hinduism. The word 'Kara' means work or labor, and 'An' refers to a male. Thus, "Devkaran" translates to "God's work" or "God's laborer." The name thus encapsulates the idea of an individual engaged in divine work and upholding dharma (duty and righteousness) in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Devkaran" holds immense spiritual significance in Hindu culture. It emphasizes that every individual is not merely an isolated entity, but an integral part of the divine scheme of things. The name inspires an individual to see their actions as integral to the cosmic order, sparking a sense of responsibility and duty towards their society and the universe as a whole. The person named Devkaran is reminded that their work is not just for their own benefit but is a part of the divine plan and contributes towards the greater good. This name also reinforces the idea of living a righteous and dharmic life, as one's actions have a profound impact not just on their own existence, but on the cosmos.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Devkaran: God (Deva) carrier (Karan). Symbolizes one who is dedicated to carrying the divine will and mission of the gods.

name_in_real_life.story: Radha Devkaran, a teacher in Mumbai, India, shares that their name Devkaran meaning "God's labor, God's work" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
